correctness.rationale: Kohl–Olsen–Sanyal source describes BB(n) as full-dimensional convex hull of all signed permutation matrices and supplies complete facet normals eps⊗e_i and e_i⊗eps with support 1. Both families have squared Frobenius norm n and are centrally symmetric spanning sets. Origin-centered enclosing balls of radius sqrt n contain all vertices; any ± antipodal contact forces radius at least sqrt n and unique center 0. Opposite facet slabs of width 2/sqrt n force inradius <=1/sqrt n and, as normals span, force unique incenter 0; equal-normal-length facets yield contact at all faces. Polarity swaps vertex and facet roles, repeating the argument for C(n). n=1 gives [-1,1]. No John/Löwner general optimal ellipsoid claim or metric invariance under nonsingular transforms.
residual_risks: Proof assumes exact complete irredundant facet representation from primary source and standard ambient Frobenius metric.
